query.sql: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM host_metrics ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Average CPU utilization per minute for the selected hosts in the selected region, as a percentage.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE region = :region AND host = ANY(:host) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Average memory utilization per minute for the selected hosts in the selected region, as a percentage.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, avg(mem_pct) AS memory FROM host_metrics WHERE region = :region AND host = ANY(:host) GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Fleet by region
panels.description: Number of distinct hosts reporting in each region over the window.

query.sql: SELECT region, count(DISTINCT host) AS hosts FROM host_metrics GROUP BY region ORDER BY hosts DESC

panels.title: Peak CPU, last 24 hours
panels.description: The highest CPU sample per selected host over the last day, as a percentage.

query.sql: SELECT host, max(cpu_pct) AS peak_cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE region = :region AND host = ANY(:host) GROUP BY host ORDER BY peak_cpu DESC

panels.title: CPU spread per host
panels.description: Every 5-minute average as a tick, one row per host, against the 85% line: where each host usually sits, and how far it strays.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', ts) AS period, host, avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics WHERE region = :region AND host = ANY(:host) GROUP BY period, host ORDER BY period
